normalized.description: Connect a ChatGPT or Claude account and sync its conversation history into the brain automatically. Cookie paste-in is the primary lane; sync is incremental (watermark + trailing-window gap-heal), and can run on a schedule via autopilot or host cron. Distinct from the export-file lane (that lives in conversation-archive) — this is the LIVE, account-connected, auto-scraping path.
normalized.name: chat-connectors
